mods.name: Fr0sty's BT2P
mods.author: Fr0sty
mods.summary: Fixes and BO1 extras for Zombies Declassified: voice lines, No Man's Land, Moon/Shangri-La fixes.
mods.description: An add-on for Logo2K's Zombies Declassified (the BO1 DLC5 maps on Plutonium T6). It brings the maps closer to how they played in Black Ops 1: missing sounds and character quotes, fixed special zombies, and a playable No Man's Land start on Moon, plus Grief and Turned on Kino der Toten and perma perks on every DLC5 map.
features: Moon - No Man's Land start: endless zombies that get tougher every minute, hellhound waves, survival clock, 7 perks, Mystery Box and wall buys
Kino der Toten: Grief and Turned modes, per-team revive icons
Perma perks on DLC5 maps (on by default, switch in Custom Games)
Thousands of BO1 character lines each map was missing, only from that map's own recordings
Moon: BO1 gate and alarm sounds, round-change music every round
Shangri-La: screamer / napalm fixes, baby gun works on special zombies again
Gersh Device, Wunderwaffe box odds, Death Machine sounds and icons like BO1
changelog: Shangri-La: fixed the screamer crash (blank textures in 2.0.5's mod.ff - also fixes the comic-book effect textures)
Shangri-La: shrunk napalm zombies can be stomped and kicked again
Shangri-La: napalm zombies jog instead of sprinting
Shangri-La: the screamer spawn effect and sound play once (they played twice)
Moon: you get your own character's arms back when you lose the P.E.S.
Fixed a crash when leaving a match
